title: CreateRequestMetadata
description: A CreateRequest carrying client metadata. Same record and decoder as create_request; this pair pins the metadata-carrying shape.

id.description: Opaque UTF-8 identity; Core enforces the 256-byte limit.

metadata.description: Client-supplied app-defined string fields. Core also enforces: 1 to 16 fields; keys match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ and do not begin with looprig; values are at most 1024 bytes of UTF-8 with no C0 control other than tab and newline; the canonical encoding of the object is at most 4096 bytes.

principal.description: The verified sender a Factory stamped after credential verification. Never client-supplied: a Factory refuses a request that carries it.
